name: Black-Friday-Deals (mRs-)
accepts: Software deals in 22 categories. iOS and Mac apps are listed.
how_to_submit: Pull request adding one YAML file per deal at deals/<year>/<category>/<app>.yml against the master branch, or the form at https://blackfriday.mariuslandwehr.com/submit/ (needs a GitHub account; it pre-fills the same file and opens the pull request for you).
entry_format: YAML with name, url, description, discount, terms, starts, ends (and percent where used). The README tables and the website are built from the files after each merge.
rules: Never edit the README; it is generated from the YAML files.
Only offers for the current season. One deal per product, in the single most relevant category.
State the discount and the code, or say that it is applied automatically. No sale-page proof or checkout verification is required.
First come, first served: deals are listed in the order they were merged.
Pull request template (since 11 Nov 2026), three boxes: one file per deal and no README edit; valid for the 2026 season; listed once in its most relevant category. No licence box.
status_note: 335 pull requests from outside authors merged since 1 Oct 2026, the latest on 19 Nov 2026; 55 open; 31 closed without a merge, the recent ones withdrawn or without comment.
recommended_for: software deals in 22 categories; iOS and Mac apps listed
